answer: Students can withdraw without academic penalty until the end of week 8 and receive a W. After week 8, withdrawal is also permitted. A 50% tuition refund is available through the end of week 4.
sources: Students may withdraw from a course without academic penalty until the end of week 8 and receive a grade of W. After week 8, withdrawal is permitted only with written approval from the Dean of Students.
Students receive a full tuition refund if they drop a course before the start of week 2 and a 50% refund through the end of week 4. No refund is given after week 4.

answer: Employees can work remotely up to three days a week if their manager approves. New hires are allowed to work remotely from their very first day. Home internet costs are not reimbursed.
sources: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval. Requests must be submitted at least 14 days before the start of a new arrangement. Remote work is not available during the first 90 days of employment.
Remote employees must be reachable during core hours of 10:00 to 15:00 local time. Equipment such as laptops and monitors is provided by the company, but home internet costs are not reimbursed.

answer: Metformin is usually started at 500 mg once or twice daily with meals. Doses can be raised by 500 mg each week up to about 2,000 mg daily. It is safe to use in patients whose eGFR is below 30.
sources: Metformin is typically started at 500 mg once or twice daily with meals to reduce gastrointestinal side effects. The dose may be increased gradually, by 500 mg weekly, to a maximum of 2,000 mg per day in most adults.

Metformin is contraindicated in patients with an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) below 30 mL/min/1.73 m². Treatment should be temporarily stopped before procedures involving iodinated contrast in patients at risk of kidney injury.
